title: Remove bulk-select checkbox and bulk-selection wiring from List view task rows

requirements.summary: Remove the left-side bulk-select checkbox from List view task rows so only the completion checkbox remains.
acceptanceCriteria: In List view, each task row renders exactly one checkbox control (the completion checkbox).
The leftmost/bulk-select checkbox is not rendered anywhere in the task list rows.
There is no duplicate checkbox UI in the task list rows (matches the screenshot intent).
The remaining checkbox continues to toggle task completion/reopen as it did previously.

file_operations.description: Remove the conditional selection checkbox block and any selection-related props usage so each task row renders only the completion checkbox while keeping the existing completion toggle behavior intact.
Update TaskItem rendering in the list to stop passing any selection-related props so the task row cannot render a bulk-select checkbox.

requirements.summary: Disable bulk-selection wiring in List view so selection props/state are not used and the bulk actions bar never appears from leftover selection state.
acceptanceCriteria: Task rows do not receive or depend on selection props for rendering a selection checkbox.
The bulk actions selection UI does not appear as a result of any default/leftover selection state after this change.
No user-facing text regressions are introduced; any visible labels remain in English.

file_operations.description: Remove bulk-selection state and handlers (selectedTasks, select/clear callbacks), stop conditionally rendering TaskBulkActionsBar, and stop passing selection props into TaskList so no leftover selection state can trigger bulk actions UI.
Remove selection-related props from TaskList’s public interface and internal TaskItem prop wiring so List view no longer depends on selection state for rendering.
Remove selection-related props (isSelected/onSelect) from TaskItem’s public interface so the row component no longer supports selection-checkbox rendering via props.
